book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: U Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLOXEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU ROMA U uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Roma uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ uvaꞌ Tiixh kat txaaon unqꞌa tiaal Israel
As ootzimal taꞌn u Cristo uvaꞌ jik chit la yolon in sete. As yeꞌl yol nunchuli, tan aꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu ni alon sve uvaꞌ jik chit nunyolon sete.
As at umaꞌl u mam txumuꞌm tu u vaanxelal uvaꞌ nichꞌoꞌnsan vaama sbꞌenameen,

tan ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ la koj uchi as la tal u Tiixheꞌ unkameꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa unpaaveꞌ as la teesa kan in Aak kꞌatz u Cristo tiꞌ toksat Aak unqꞌa tiaal Israel, kꞌatz u Cristo sunvaatzil. As bꞌaꞌn la ibꞌan veꞌt Aak te unqꞌa tiaal Israel,

tan aꞌ unqꞌa tiaal Israel uvaꞌ kat ok smeꞌal ikꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ. As kat atin veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ sxoꞌl. As kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ kan Aak u akꞌ tzaqꞌiteꞌ. As kat tal kan Aak kam toksal iqꞌii Aak. As kat talkat kan Aak kam uvaꞌ la ibꞌan Aak te unqꞌa itenameꞌ.

As tiaal Israel unqꞌa qꞌesla kubꞌaaleꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ. As an chit xoꞌl unqꞌa tiaal Israel kat itzꞌebꞌkat u Cristo uvaꞌ Tiixh. As Aakeꞌ nim talcheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil. As la qoksa veꞌt iqꞌii Aak tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ. An chiteꞌ.
As jit kajayil unqꞌa tiaal Israel kat ok sitenam Tiixh. As yeꞌle uvaꞌ yeꞌ koj kat itzojpisa Aak u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan Aak te u Abraham.
As jit tiꞌ uvaꞌ tiaal u Abraham unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as kat ok veꞌt smeꞌal ikꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ. Pet ech kat tal Aak ileꞌ te u Abraham:

content.text: Tan tiꞌ u Isaac la kaakat unqꞌa aviaaleꞌ, tiꞌk Aak.

content: As ech qootziteꞌ uvaꞌ jit kajayil unqꞌa tiaal u Abraham kat ok smeꞌal ikꞌaol Tiixh. Pet taꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat tal kan Aak uvaꞌ la ok veꞌt smeꞌal ikꞌaol Aak, as aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tiaal u Abraham vatz Aak,
tan ech ni tal u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan te u Abraham:

content.text: As tu u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn Aak, as la ul in sekꞌatz unpajte.
As la itzꞌebꞌ umaꞌl vineꞌ u Sara. As xaak la ibꞌaneꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Tiixheꞌ te u Abraham.

content: As jit taꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan Aak, tul kat tal Aak u yoleꞌ te u Sara. Pet echat kat ibꞌan Aak tiꞌ kaꞌvaꞌt unqꞌa tal u Rebecaeꞌ, uvaꞌ ikꞌaol u qꞌesla kubꞌaaleꞌ uvaꞌ Isaac.

As tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnik itzꞌebꞌ kaꞌvaꞌl unqꞌa talaj xaakeꞌ as yeꞌxhkam unbꞌooj maꞌtik ibꞌanataꞌ as kꞌuxh bꞌaꞌn as moj yeꞌ bꞌaꞌn, as kat tal u Tiixheꞌ umaꞌl u yol tiꞌ unqꞌa neꞌeꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la jalpu isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn Aak tiꞌ itxaat Aak unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ tok sitenam Aak. As jit tiꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ kat itxaakat Aak. Pet Aakeꞌ kat alon abꞌil la itxaa Aak.
As ech tal u Tiixh ileꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tal u Rebeca:

content.text: La ok u atzikaeꞌ kꞌamil xeꞌ u itzꞌinaeꞌ, tiꞌk Aak.

content: As kat ibꞌana echeꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan, tan ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ:

content.text: Kat unxoꞌni veꞌt u Jacob.
Pet ech koj u Esaú, tan yeꞌ kat voksa veꞌt stuul, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: ¿As kam qꞌi la qaleꞌ? ¿Ma la qaleꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh kat ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ, tul kat itxaa Aak u itzꞌinaeꞌ? ¡Yeꞌle!
As ech kat tal Aak ileꞌ te u Moisés unpajte:

content.text: Ineꞌ la alon abꞌil uvaꞌ la untxum ivatz, as la chit untxum ivatzeꞌ;
as ineꞌ la alon abꞌil uvaꞌ la unbꞌan bꞌaꞌnil ste, as la chit unbꞌan bꞌaꞌnileꞌ ste, tiꞌk Aak.

content: As jit uveꞌ ni tal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ as mitaꞌn jit tiꞌ umaj kam uvaꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ kat itxaakat Aak. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ Aak kat alon, as estiꞌeꞌ kat itxaa Aak unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tan Aak ni txumun ivatz.
As echeꞌ umaꞌt u yol uvaꞌ tal Aak te u Faraón uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan, tan ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: As tuk val see uvaꞌ kat voksa axh sbꞌooqꞌolil tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ,
aqꞌal uvaꞌ la pal axh stuul uvaꞌ at pal u vijleꞌmeꞌ seeꞌ,
as aqꞌal uvaꞌ la paxsal untzibꞌlal xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tiꞌk Aak,

content: tan la itxum Aak ivatz umaj uxhchil, abꞌil uvaꞌ la tal Aak itxumat ivatz. As la itiibꞌisa Aak taama umaj uxhchil, abꞌil uvaꞌ la tal Aak itiibꞌisal taama.
Pet kamal at umaj ex uvaꞌ ech la etal ileꞌ: «Asoj ech ni tal Aakeꞌ, as ¿kam qꞌi uvaꞌ ni toksa Aak u kupaaveꞌ stuul? Tan techal chit la kubꞌaneꞌ, asoj Aak la alon,» chaj ex la etaleꞌ.
As la val sete, ¿as ma at etijleꞌm uvaꞌ la ebꞌekꞌ u Tiixheꞌ? Tan echeꞌ la koj uch talat u tzꞌaj ukꞌaleꞌ te u bꞌitol tetzeꞌ uvaꞌ: «¿Kam qꞌi uvaꞌ vaꞌlen kuxh vucheꞌ kat abꞌana?» ma chaj la taleꞌ,

tan at tijleꞌm u bꞌanol ukꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ kam uvaꞌ ni tal taama tiꞌ u chaxkabꞌeꞌ, tan la uch ibꞌanat bꞌaꞌnla laj uvaꞌ chꞌiꞌumal tiloneꞌ tukꞌ u chaxkabꞌeꞌ. As an chit tukꞌ u chaxkabꞌeꞌ la uch ibꞌanat kaꞌt laj uvaꞌ kam kuxh veꞌt lajil.

¿As ma la uch etalat tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh uveꞌ nibꞌan Aak tul uvaꞌ nim taama Aak nibꞌan tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni niman Aak? Tan kꞌuxh ni tal Aak uvaꞌ la ikꞌuch Aak vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌleꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tukꞌ viyakꞌileꞌ, as nim chit taama Aak kat ibꞌan tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at veꞌt tzan vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌl Aakeꞌ stiꞌ. As yeꞌ kat isotzsa Aak u tenameꞌ taꞌn vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌleꞌ.
As kat itxum Aak kuvatz. As kat ikꞌuch Aak sqe uvaꞌ nim talchu veꞌt Aak. As aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat titzꞌa Aak naꞌytzan tiꞌ uvaꞌ la qootzi uvaꞌ nim talchu veꞌt Aak.
Oꞌ uvaꞌ kat imolo veꞌt oꞌ Aak, kꞌuxh oꞌ tiaal Israel as moj jit oꞌ tiaal Israel,
tan echeꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa kan taꞌn u Oseas. As ech tal Aak ileꞌ:

content.text: «Untenam,» chaj in la valeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jitik untenam.
«Xoꞌn veꞌt ex sve,» chaj in la valeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ xoꞌnik sve, tiꞌk Aak.

content: As ech kat tal Aak ileꞌ unpajte:

content.text: «As katil kuxhtuꞌ uvaꞌ la alpukat uvaꞌ jit ex untenam
as tzitziꞌ la alpukat uvaꞌ ex meꞌal unkꞌaol,» tiꞌk u islich Tiixheꞌ.

content: As ech kat tal kan u Isaías ileꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tiaal Israel:

content.text: As kꞌuxh ech u tachul unqꞌa tiaal Israel echeꞌ tatin u sanabꞌeꞌ tziꞌ u mar,
as yeꞌxh jankꞌal unqꞌa tiaal Israel la kolax vatz u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ,
tan techal chit tuk ibꞌan u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ kam uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn Aak, tiꞌk u Isaías.

content: As ech tuk ibꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌtik talat kan u Isaías uvaꞌ ech tal ileꞌ:

content.text: As yeꞌ koj kat tal kan u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil la pal tiꞌ vitxumbꞌal Aakeꞌ, uvaꞌ yeꞌ la sotz veꞌt unqꞌa tiaal Israel,
as ech u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ la ul sqiꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ ibꞌan unqꞌa aa Sodoma tukꞌ unqꞌa aa Gomorra, tiꞌk u Isaías.

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ unqꞌa tiaal Israel uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni niman u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ

As la pal veꞌt oꞌ stuul uvaꞌ kꞌuxh yeꞌ nik titzꞌa unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel u jikla txumbꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ tok sjikla aamail vatz u Tiixheꞌ, as kat ok veꞌt jikla aamail vatz Aak. As tiꞌ kuxh u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ.
Pet ech koj unqꞌa tiaal Israel, tan kꞌuxh nikat titzꞌa u jikla txumbꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ tok jikla aamail vatz Aak, as yeꞌ kat ok jikla aamail.

¿As kam stiꞌ qꞌi uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat ok jikla aamail? Tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Cristo. Pet aꞌ kat tala uvaꞌ la ok jikla aamail tiꞌ inimat u tzaqꞌiteꞌ. As yeꞌ kat bꞌex ibꞌana, tan ech kat ibꞌan unqꞌa tiaal Israel echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ kat itxꞌet toj tiꞌ umaj kꞌubꞌ,
echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal umaꞌt u yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Paloj ex stuul uvaꞌ tuk unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ umaꞌl u uxhchil uvaꞌ ech tatineꞌ echeꞌ kꞌubꞌ tu u Sion.
As nimal uxhchil uvaꞌ yeꞌ la saꞌon.
Pet abꞌil uvaꞌ la ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl stiꞌ, as echeꞌ la koj eesal iqꞌii, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.
